Can you compare your two most popular options and tell me which is better for me?
Two of our top choices for everyday wear are the Coastal Cottage Embroidered Tunic Dress and the Seaside Tunic Dress.
The Coastal Cottage Embroidered Tunic Dress ($72, originally $144) features 3/4 sleeves, a flattering V-neckline, and detailed embroidery in lightweight UPF 50+ fabric. It offers exceptional value if you want a classic embroidered look at a great price.
The Seaside Tunic Dress ($144) offers a light blue diamond print with an inverse pattern trim on the V-neckline and sleeve cuffs. It is a timeless piece crafted from our signature breathable UPF 50+ fabric.
If value for money is your priority, the Coastal Cottage Embroidered Tunic Dress is an ideal choice with its current sale price. If you prefer a classic, print-focused style without embroidery, the Seaside Tunic Dress is a great option.
